source: HistData official Generic ASCII tick quotes, XAUUSD
download_method: at most two concurrent HistData months, each with sequential GET of official download page then POST of its file_down form to https://www.histdata.com/get.php; no form token published; bounded retries for transient 5xx only
published_source_timezone: EST fixed UTC-5, no DST according to HistData documentation

requested_empirical_clock_correction.u0: source label interpreted as a naive clock plus 5 hours, expressed as UTC
requested_empirical_clock_correction.u: u0 minus one hour if u0 falls in European summer time in Europe/Berlin; otherwise u0
requested_empirical_clock_correction.independent_confirmation_for_xauusd: see CONTROLE_DUKASCOPY.json; must not infer from EURUSD
requested_empirical_clock_correction.boundary_policy: half-open European DST UTC intervals generated with zoneinfo Europe/Berlin; never use US DST

source_archives: 2019-12 through 2026-10; prior source month is included only for the left UTC boundary
output_files: one CSV per UTC month; CRLF records as in the reference format
price_precision: exact base-10 integers at scale 1e9, input precision at most nine decimals; output at least five decimals with all significant source digits retained
open_close: earliest/latest event timestamp; equal timestamps retain source order
n_ticks: count of original quote records, including equal-timestamp records; never source volume
missing_minutes: every UTC minute without a bar, including weekends and holidays; an absence is not proof of market closure
